items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1958-05-31
items.q: He had Cartel on drums. And Cartel played timpanis too.

ctx.x: And the musicians who were in his big orchestra?
Yeah, they had Armand Piron, Peter Bocard, Nanya Perez, George Moray, Big Gasper, George Field, Shalini. He had Cartel on drums. And Cartel played timpanis too. Played what? Timpanis.
